competency_statement_fil: TESDA BHS NC II — Contribute to Workplace Innovation: natutukoy ng BHW ang pagkakataong mapabuti ang gawain dahil sa mga pagbabagong dulot ng UHC Act, napag-uusapan ito sa kapwa BHW o midwife, at nakapagsisimula ng konkretong hakbang tungo sa pagpapatupad ng ideya.
competency_statement_en: TESDA BHS NC II — Contribute to Workplace Innovation: the BHW identifies opportunities to improve their work arising from the UHC Act's changes, discusses these with a fellow BHW or the midwife, and begins a concrete step toward carrying the idea out.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Naipapaliwanag ng BHW, gamit ang sariling salita, ang layunin ng UHC Act at hindi bababa sa tatlo sa apat na konkretong pagbabago nito (PhilHealth coverage, outpatient consult, primary care provider, referral system).
observation_indicators.observable_en: The BHW explains, in their own words, the UHC Act's goal and at least three of its four concrete changes (PhilHealth coverage, outpatient consultation, primary care provider, referral system).
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Nasasabi lamang na 'may bagong batas tungkol sa kalusugan' nang walang partikular na pagbabagong mababanggit, o inaakalang libre na ang lahat.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Only says 'there's a new health law' with no specific change named, or assumes everything is now free.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Naipapaliwanag nang tama ang layunin at hindi bababa sa tatlong pagbabago, walang untag.
levels.kaya_na_en: Explains the goal and at least three changes correctly, unprompted.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Naaalala ang layunin pero isa o dalawa lang sa apat na pagbabago ang natutukoy.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Recalls the goal but identifies only one or two of the four changes.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Hindi maiugnay ang UHC Act sa anumang tiyak na pagbabago.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Cannot connect the UHC Act to any specific change at all.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Nakapagbibigay ang BHW ng tiyak na paghahambing kung alin sa mga pagbabago ang naramdaman na sa sariling barangay at alin ang hindi pa, batay sa tunay na obserbasyon.
observation_indicators.observable_en: The BHW gives a specific comparison of which changes are already felt in their own barangay and which are not yet, based on real observation.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Pangkalahatang sagot lamang ('marami na, may kaunti pa rin') nang walang tiyak na halimbawa mula sa sariling barangay.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Gives only a general answer ('mostly, with a bit left') with no specific example from their own barangay.

levels.kaya_na_fil: May tiyak na halimbawa para sa hindi bababa sa dalawa sa apat na pagbabago, batay sa aktwal na obserbasyon.
levels.kaya_na_en: Gives a specific example for at least two of the four changes, based on actual observation.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: May pangkalahatang ideya pero isang halimbawa lamang ang tiyak.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Has a general sense but only one example is specific.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Hindi maihambing ang sitwasyon ng sariling barangay sa alinman sa apat na pagbabago.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Cannot compare their own barangay's situation to any of the four changes.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Naipapahayag ng BHW nang malinaw sa kapwa BHW o midwife ang isang tiyak na mungkahi para mapabuti ang pagpapatupad ng UHC, at nakikinig din sa naibabalik na puna.
observation_indicators.observable_en: The BHW clearly states one specific suggestion to a fellow BHW or the midwife for improving how UHC is carried out, and listens to the feedback that comes back.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Nananatili sa reklamo ('hindi maganda ang takbo dito') nang walang partikular na mungkahi, o hindi ito talagang naipaparating sa iba.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Stays at complaint level ('this isn't working well here') with no specific suggestion, or never actually raises it with anyone else.

levels.kaya_na_fil: May tiyak na mungkahi na naipahayag nang malinaw, at may buod ng napag-usapan pagkatapos.
levels.kaya_na_en: States a specific suggestion clearly, and can summarize what was discussed afterward.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: May mungkahi pero kailangan pa ng tulong para maipahayag ito nang malinaw sa iba.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Has a suggestion but needs help articulating it clearly to someone else.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Hindi lumalampas sa reklamo o hinaing.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Never moves past complaint or grievance.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Nakapagbibigay ang BHW ng isang maliit, konkreto, at magagawa nang hakbang bilang unang aksyon — hindi malawak o abstract na plano.
observation_indicators.observable_en: The BHW names one small, concrete, doable step as a first action — not a broad or abstract plan.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Ang naisip na hakbang ay masyadong malaki o abstract ('babaguhin ko ang buong sistema') at walang malinaw na unang gagawin.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: The proposed step is too large or abstract ('I'll change the whole system') with no clear first action.

levels.kaya_na_fil: May tiyak na hakbang na magagawa sa loob ng isang linggo, may petsa o pagkakataong sinabi.
levels.kaya_na_en: Has a specific step doable within a week, with a stated date or occasion.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: May pangkalahatang direksyon pero hindi pa tiyak kung ano at kailan ang unang gagawin.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Has a general direction but is not yet specific about what the first action is or when.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Nananatili sa antas ng ideya nang walang balak na aksyon.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Stays at the level of an idea, with no intended action.
